name: fé fiada
text: fé fiada is a variant spelling of the Irish headword féth fiada, the magical concealing mist. MacKillop records both spellings as pointing to the same canonical headword féth fiada. The fuller record of the warrior's protective mist sits under féth fiada in the 2008 dictionary.

okr.objective: fé fiada is a MacKillop pointer headword.
key_results: Pointer cites the headword féth fiada for the full record.
Variant spelling recorded in the 2008 dictionary.
